purpose: Test whether the breeding-space concentration rule transfers from within-colony/subcolony systems to regional networks of monitored Antarctic penguin breeding sites using only the already-pinned MAPPPD snapshot.

source.cohort_rule: Reuse the frozen Paper 2 1980-2025 bridged nest-count cohort and observation-calibration code without changing record selection.

hierarchy.interpretation: regional monitored breeding-site network; not assumed to be a closed demographic population

fixed_roster_algorithm: Start with every frozen-cohort site_id in a species x region.
Complete seasons are seasons observed at every retained site.
If support fails, remove the site with the fewest observed seasons; break ties by removing the lexicographically greatest site_id.
Stop at the first qualifying roster; fail if fewer than three sites remain.

outcome_definition.site_season_state: Reuse Paper 2 method-corrected precision collapse of repeated same-season counts on log1p scale, then transform back with expm1.
outcome_definition.abundance_direction: OLS slope of log(N_t) on calendar year; negative denotes a declining monitored network

nulls.fixed_composition: Pool adjusted site counts across retained complete seasons to q_j; at each observed total N_t draw multinomial(round(N_t), q), preserving the observed total trajectory.
nulls.observation_error_sensitivity: After multinomial thinning, add independent normal error on log1p scale using each collapsed site-season observation variance, transform back, and recompute E while keeping observed N_t as the scaling x-axis.

support_call: A panel shows excess regional concentration only if delta_kappa > 0 and one-sided p <= 0.05 under both the fixed-composition null and the observation-error sensitivity.
bounded_questions: How many species x APBP-region networks are structurally estimable?
Among declining estimable networks, how often is delta_kappa positive and individually supported?
Does the direction of the previously discovered concentration rule transfer to this larger spatial scale?
stop_rule: Do not open alternate geographic radii, hand-built clusters, alternate completeness thresholds, alternate abundance transformations, lags, collapse hinges, or trait searches in response to this result.
